subject: tr-info
title: (R)TR.INFO. -----ACC.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 256 (CMOA(II)-14). TR-INFO (trans-information) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) and RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From EXP-DYM: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From RT-INT-TR: LK-IMP (linkage implications), IST-PT (isolated particulars) and CULT-SOLD (culture solidification). From INFO-AF-B: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: PART (participation).
